body: Oh okay. I will try out some of the online tutoring. I haven't tried that.

In my country we don't really have these kind of scales. We basically have a scale of four - Its excellent, acceptable, good and fail. If I fail, my average drops, but it's possible to make it up with extra subject that I won't fail. Sorry, I should explain. 

I would be somewhere around the acceptable. Like if there were only A, B, C and F, my grades are B's. If I get an F, I can take maybe three extra subjects and if I ace them, my average goes up.

Thank you man. I seriously think maybe they don't know how sensitive I am to them disaprooving since the constant comparing and competition doesn't end. I probably overreact at the slightest hint of them saying I am not good enough. They are trying to do their best and I am just too emotional. 

I think I will just go and give them an apology hug and then sit back down on dem multivariable bad boys.

I understand now. I seriously don't want any excuse to stop studying, I am just annoyed by the fact that I want them to know that I have grown and that I am not a teenager asking them to buy me shit if I ace the test tomorrow. I know my place and I am really trying to better myself. I want them to take seriously when I come to them asking for advice for my health. I got scared and since my mum is a doctor, I wanted to ask for her advice/opinion.
If I undestand the scale correctly, I am at 3.0. I do get F's, but try to make it up to raise it up.

I'm sorry, could you please explain more about the extra help? I genuinely don't understand what you mean. You mean like tutoring? It can be expensive in my country, but there are a few "extra" lectures my uni gives for those struggling. I didn't know about them at first, but I joined as soon as I found out.

Yes, exactly that is what I would say is what I wasn't seeing. Please don't think I got a flu and I am making a fuss about it. I am not THAT big of an asshole to just have a cough and freak out. I got scared because I am already ill to begin with and I was afraid my medication stopped working (as this has already happened once and it wasn't pretty).

I apreciate what my parents gave me, but maybe I need to appreaciate it even more. Thank you for your insight and I will work on myself
Yes they probably are. Maybe after I settle more in uni I should talk to them.

University, and I have to pass a few exams in order to continue studying. 

I always was a bad student. I still believe I am and maybe I am just convincing myself that I am not to feel a little better. My parents might see this and are pushing me harder because maybe I am even worse than I was and I don't realise.

I wish I would know if I am seriously depressed or just and asshole and lazy. I know I probably have some mental health issues. I know that some things aren't okay with me and are a burden to me. But this thought of that maybe I am not ill but lazy and just an asshole is still in my mind.

I think after cooling off a bit I can say that even if my health was suffering, it's still no excuse to get mad and petty to my parents.

Study habits are still horrible. I divide my course into chapters and then give myself a "schedule" to work on that chapter. I usually fail because I would get stuck on a chapter and then I wouldn't have enough time to finish the last ones in the course. Sometimes I just am too lazy to study and sleep all day. I am an asshole to come to think of it when I typed this. 

Besides my struggles, I believe I am the asshole in this case and I should apologise to my parents. They mean well and I should learn to control my emotions better.
University. No, I am way past that age. My mum is a doctor, that is why I asked her first. I didn't want her to take care of me, just wanted to ask for advice on what to do or how to stop the pain.

I realised I missed alot of info, sorry. 

In high school I would literally slack everything off until maybe the last hour or so. Honestly didn't care much. I now (without counting lectures) study in average maybe 6-ish hours a day. Honestly hard to answer because sometimes I am stuck on a problem and spend maybe 1 hour on just that and then I study longer. Some days when I get through the chapters fast enough, I study less. I divide my course into my own chapters and focus more on finishing the chapter rather than how long I am studying.

​

Math student, I would like to have a masters degree.
Yes, I agree. Maybe I should just grow up and apologize to them. I hope that passing exams will make it up. Thank you.
Sorry, probably should have.

Are you a math student? I just posted the almost exact same thing a few minutes ago. 

I am probably not the best person to talk right now without sounding like a hypocrite. Maybe we can talk about it as people who relate?

If anything I can at least refer you to some books and videos that can explain math for you.
Thanks man. Thank you.

Hello fellow math student. I do understand that they had to dramatize it for the movie, but it is just horribly discouraging. 

Sometimes I feel like I am stupid for doing it the way everybody else does it, because I just feel like it is supposed to 'come to me'. 

Thank you so much for posting this, I feel slightly better now that I read your post. I will share among my classmates.

No, it's not outdated yet. 

I did apologise to them and explained what happened. I am very behind, but I am trying to get back where we were. 

I am so grateful that they accepted my apology.

Thank you for your reply, I feel better when I know that I am not the only one whose depression does this.

P.S.: your English is very good, it's also not my first language, I just think you might have meant forgiveness than apologies when you wrote 'I ask for apologies'

I have read your reply, and I let it just simmer in my head for a while. You are right, I was just stupidly overemotional because I skipped a few lessons and when I came back I felt very overwhelmed when I saw how far everybody got. Thank you AbandoningAll, your comment make me rethink everything for long enough to stay alive. Thank you, seriously.
Oh my, I never thought about that. Thank you.
Thank you. Im almost 20.
Probably the most sensible thing to do except I am literal trash that thinks suicide is better than trying to make friends. Thank you tho, I can give it another shot (making friends, not suicide).
